fusions.name: Scent-Trail Finish
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A finishing blow that deals 18 damage and uses up every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit.

fusions.name: Tagged for the Pack
fusions.desc: Sends a jet of musk at an enemy up to 8 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 2 times that at maximum range, with a 30% chance to leave it [Marked] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Slipped the Leash
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a hound on the scent for 15 seconds. It bites an enemy within 5 tiles every 1.5 seconds for 4 damage, with a 40% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Quarry Worn Down
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 15% more damage.
